acknowledged_and_rejected_contract.expected: every non-fault operation acknowledged; faulted supersede rejected; no indeterminate

fresh_empty_database_preflight.expected: one pre-store check proving zero user relations

fresh_process_restart.expected: distinct boot nonce and process-instance identity

load_window_exact.expected: one canonical decimal window enclosing every measured intent/outcome; elapsed=end-start and equals measurement summary elapsed_ns

marker_exactly_once_and_rejected_zero.expected: each expected live marker once; deleted and rejected markers zero

one_outcome_per_intent.expected: one terminal outcome for each unique intent and no orphan outcomes

supersession_state.expected: old head points to new row and new row points back to old head
